name: Campingplatz Ortnerhof
beschreibung:
Campingplatz Ortnerhof welcomes guests with a magnificent backdrop of lush meadows and imposing peaks. Along with first-rate sanitary facilities, the site features spacious pitches and modern camper amenities.

Whether hiking through untouched valleys, cycling scenic routes, or relaxing amidst nature, the campsite is an idyllic base for both families and active explorers.
kurzbeschreibung: Campingplatz Ortnerhof combines alpine outdoor adventure with high comfort and warm family hospitality.
